description: This file contains utility functions for string formatting, specifically to convert strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and trimming whitespace. Returns the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display purposes, handling delimiters, whitespace, apostrophes, and accented characters. Returns the original value if not a string.
